summary: Short, steep, tree-covered dead end beside apartments 8 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 8 m and 13 m from the kerb, homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane under trees with two cars at its end; no spare room.
drivers.traffic: Very quiet end of a residential lane.
drivers.convention: No signs; a couple of cars parked at the lane end, likely residents.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of the stretch.
